expectation: CD206 (MRC1) should be a membrane/cytoplasmic stain on a minority of scattered macrophages, plus some dendritic and endothelial cells. In gut it should sit in the lamina propria or submucosa, mostly as single cells or loose clusters, and not along the epithelium.
observed: A: diffuse yellow haze over the mucosa with speckle in the lamina propria. B/C: haze plus a granular line along the epithelial edge. D: one bright irregular blob. E: CD206 clumps overlap many CD163 cells (white), but green grain also sits in CD163-negative tissue.
why: A subset of CD206 signal sits on CD163 macrophage clusters, but it is low contrast and mixed with tissue-following haze and epithelial-edge grain.
